cases.source_reason: HRegionServer.putUpWebUI @2482 checks Addressing.isLocalAddress(InetAddress.getByName(addr)) where addr comes from hbase.regionserver.info.bindAddress or hbase.master.info.bindAddress (default 0.0.0.0). The InfoServer bind and HTTP workload occur after this guard; an I/O exception at the resolution call exits before the selected predicate rather than changing the configured address. Existing TestInfoServers#testInfoServersRedirect exercises startup and pages, but does not supply an I/O-influenced address.
cases.next_gate: Only revisit if an existing passing cluster test demonstrably supplies a dynamic bind address and yields an observed pretarget fault door; otherwise retain a source-reviewed static false-positive label.
